theses.thesis: T1: AWS keeps compounding fast enough to fund the capex build-out.
theses.signpost: AWS sales growth of at least 18% and operating margin of at least 35% in each 2026 quarterly report; invalidation below 15% growth or below 33% margin.

theses.thesis: T2: Capex peaks and free cash flow recovers in 2026.
theses.signpost: FY2026 free cash flow above $25bn in the February 2027 10-K, with capex growth slowing; invalidation at or below $11.2bn, or new borrowing used to fund operations.

theses.thesis: T3: The valuation requires above-trend growth, so returns are exposed to any slowdown.
theses.signpost: FY2026 reported revenue at or above the $829bn consensus in the February 2027 10-K; invalidation below 15% FY2026 growth.

theses.thesis: T4: Regulatory and legal costs stay contained relative to the earnings base.
theses.signpost: No new settlement or tax reserve above $2.5bn disclosed in 2026 filings; invalidation by a new material FTC settlement or adverse ruling in the Indian cloud-services tax case.

theses.thesis: T1: AWS keeps compounding fast enough to fund the capex build-out.
theses.signpost: AWS sales growth of at least 18% and operating margin of at least 35% in each 2026 quarterly report (invalidation: growth below 15% or margin below 33%).

theses.thesis: T2: Capex peaks and free cash flow recovers in 2026.
theses.signpost: FY2026 free cash flow above $25 billion in the February 2027 10-K, with capex growth slowing (invalidation: FY2026 free cash flow at or below $11.2 billion, or new borrowing used to fund operations).

theses.thesis: T3: The valuation requires above-trend growth, so returns are exposed to any slowdown.
theses.signpost: FY2026 reported revenue at or above the $829 billion consensus in the February 2027 10-K (invalidation: FY2026 revenue growth below 15%).

theses.thesis: T4: Regulatory and legal costs stay contained relative to the earnings base.
theses.signpost: No new settlement or tax reserve above $2.5 billion disclosed in 2026 filings (invalidation: a new material FTC settlement or an adverse ruling in the Indian cloud-services tax case).

theses.thesis: T1: AWS operating margin will recover above 36% in FY2026 as new infrastructure scales.
theses.signpost: AWS operating margin above 36% in the FY2026 10-K, with AWS sales growth of at least 20%. Interim test: AWS sales growth at least 18% and operating margin at least 35% each quarter (thesis log).

theses.thesis: T2: Free cash flow turns clearly positive in FY2026 as operating cash flow catches up with capex.
theses.signpost: FY2026 free cash flow above $11.2 billion on the 10-K basis, with capex growth slowing. Interim test: trailing free cash flow positive (baseline invalidation: still negative in the FY2026 10-K).

theses.thesis: T3: The stock earns its cost of capital only if revenue growth beats consensus for a decade.
theses.signpost: FY2026 revenue growth at or above 15.7% in the FY2026 10-K, and consensus FY2027 revenue not revised down from $960.5 billion. Interim test: reported revenue at or above $829 billion consensus (thesis log).

theses.thesis: T4: Gross margin keeps rising despite competitive pressure, supporting profit growth.
theses.signpost: Gross margin above 50% for FY2026 in the FY2026 10-K, with no new legal charge comparable to the $5.2 billion recorded in 2025. Interim test: no new settlement or tax reserve above $2.5 billion (thesis log).
